                    阅读8分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-f67534b4=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-f67534b4=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body cache result"><p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/9c27e0858fa94b84997959b830e2e696~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1793667606&amp;x-signature=gw2tTKahZt0W48bmRKxI4pROsl4%3D" alt="为什么我在团队里禁止使用 axios？" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>上上个月，我在我们前端团队的工程规范文档里加了一条规则：<strong>新项目禁止引入 <code>axios</code>，老项目在下一次重构周期内逐步移除。</strong></p>
<p>这条规则刚发出去，内部群就炸了。</p>
<p>有人说：<strong>用了好几年了，挺稳的，换个锤子啊🔨</strong></p>
<p>也有人发了个表情包，配文：<strong>你这不是在革我们的命吗😢？</strong></p>
<p>我理解这些反应。<code>axios</code> 在国内前端圈子里几乎是请求库的代名词。很多人入行第一天就在用，它已经不是一个技术选型的问题了。</p>
<p>但当我拆开这个项目的 <code>node_modules</code> 看了看，然后再打开 <code>MDN</code> 看了看 2026 年的 <code>fetch</code> API，我确认了一件事：<strong>大多数项目里的 <code>axios</code>，已经从解决问题的工具变成了不敢删的历史遗留。</strong></p>
<p>今天我就把决策过程摊开，给你们讲一讲👇。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-0"><code>axios</code> 到底解决了什么？那些问题今天还存在吗？</h3>
<p>先说公道话，<code>axios</code> 当年确实有它存在的理由。</p>
<p>2016 年前后，原生 <code>fetch</code> 刚落地，基本上属于能用但不好用的状态：不支持请求超时、不支持拦截器、不支持进度监控、不能自动解析 <code>JSON</code>、<code>4xx</code> 和 <code>5xx</code> 不会走 <code>catch</code>。那个年代你要发一个 HTTP 请求，<code>fetch</code> 写起来确实又臭又长。</p>
<p>但 2026 年了，浏览器的 <code>fetch</code> 已经不是当年那个半成品了：</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/2d8ac4da33dc471c9313371e78750a56~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1793667606&amp;x-signature=Kv11stAQI7UZwg3KSFlQmrxdPXE%3D" alt="Fetch 演进与 Axios 能力对比.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>你仔细看这张表。<strong><code>axios</code> 最核心的卖点——拦截器、超时、取消——要么已经被原生 API 覆盖，要么用不到 10 行封装就能实现。</strong> 而 <code>axios</code> 做不到的事情——流式响应（<code>SSE</code>、大文件流）——反而是 2026 年越来越多的业务场景真正需要的能力。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-1"><code>axios</code> 在我们项目里制造的 3 个真实问题</h3>
<p>我不是因为原生党的洁癖才做这个决定的。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-2">拦截器嵌套成了调试黑洞</h4>
<p>我们项目里有 4 层拦截器：鉴权注入、日志埋点、错误统一处理、灰度标记。每一层都在 <code>request</code> 和 <code>response</code> 上各挂了一个拦截器，总共 8 个。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/2b62112fb42e4d93b3ea8aa8475efda6~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1793667606&amp;x-signature=1hjDEljBPLIvo9HvR0fy5WzejEI%3D" alt="Axios 八层拦截器双通道图.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>当一个请求出了问题，你去调试的时候会发现：<strong>请求从你的业务代码发出去之后，要经过 4 层拦截器的变形，才真正到达网络层。</strong> 响应回来之后，又要经过 4 层拦截器的加工，才到达你的 <code>.then()</code>。中间任何一层吞掉了错误、改了 <code>header</code>、或者忘了 <code>return</code>，你都极难定位🤷‍♂️。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-3"><code>CancelToken</code> 已废弃，但代码库里到处都是</h4>
<p><code>axios</code> 的 <code>CancelToken</code> 在 <code>v0.22.0</code> 就被标记为 <code>deprecated</code> 了，官方推荐改用 <code>AbortController</code>。但我们项目里有几十处 <code>CancelToken</code> 的用法，没人敢动，因为<strong>改了怕出事，不改跑着也没问题</strong>。结果就是新代码用 <code>AbortController</code>，老代码用 <code>CancelToken</code>，两套取消机制并存，维护成本直接翻倍 😖。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-4">在 <code>Edge Runtime</code> 和 <code>SSR</code> 场景下踩坑</h4>
<p>我们有一部分接口走 <code>Cloudflare Workers</code>。<code>Workers</code> 的运行时是 <code>V8 Isolate</code>，<strong>原生支持 <code>fetch</code>，但不支持 <code>XMLHttpRequest</code></strong>。而 <code>axios</code> 在 Node 环境下底层走的是 <code>http</code> 模块，在浏览器环境下走的是 <code>XMLHttpRequest</code>——两个都不是 <code>Workers</code> 原生支持的。</p>
<p>为了让 <code>axios</code> 在 <code>Workers</code> 里跑起来，我们不得不引入适配层。这完全是在为一个本不需要的抽象层擦屁股。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">只需要 30 行代码，替掉整个 <code>axios</code></h3>
<p>下面是我们团队现在用的请求封装。没有花哨的设计模式，就是一个纯函数，逻辑全部可见，没有隐藏的拦截器链：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// lib/request.ts</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RequestConfig</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RequestInit</span> {
  timeout?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  params?: <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> | <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span> | <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>&gt;;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ApiResponse</span>&lt;T = <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-attr">code</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: T;
  <span class="hljs-attr">message</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RequestError</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_ inherited__">Error</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">status</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">response</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Response</span>;
  
  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params">message: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, status: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, response: Response</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">super</span>(message);
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'RequestError'</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">status</span> = status;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">response</span> = response;
  }
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">BASE_URL</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>.<span class="hljs-property">meta</span>.<span class="hljs-property">env</span>.<span class="hljs-property">VITE_API_BASE</span> ?? <span class="hljs-string">''</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> request&lt;T = <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>&gt;(
  <span class="hljs-attr">url</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">config</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">RequestConfig</span> = {},
): <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">ApiResponse</span>&lt;T&gt;&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { timeout = <span class="hljs-number">10_000</span>, params, headers, ...rest } = config;

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 拼接查询参数</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> queryString = params
    ? <span class="hljs-string">'?'</span> + <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">URLSearchParams</span>(
        <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">entries</span>(params).<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">[k, v]</span>) =&gt;</span> [k, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(v)])
      ).<span class="hljs-title function_">toString</span>()
    : <span class="hljs-string">''</span>;

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 超时控制</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> signal = config.<span class="hljs-property">signal</span> ?? <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortSignal</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">timeout</span>(timeout);

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 鉴权注入</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> token = <span class="hljs-variable language_">localStorage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getItem</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'access_token'</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">mergedHeaders</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">HeadersInit</span> = {
    <span class="hljs-string">'Content-Type'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'application/json'</span>,
    ...(token ? { <span class="hljs-title class_">Authorization</span>: <span class="hljs-string">`Bearer <span class="hljs-subst">${token}</span>`</span> } : {}),
    ...headers,
  };

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> response = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${BASE_URL}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${url}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${queryString}</span>`</span>, {
    ...rest,
    <span class="hljs-attr">headers</span>: mergedHeaders,
    signal,
  });

  <span class="hljs-comment">// fetch 不会在 4xx/5xx 时 reject，需要手动处理</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!response.<span class="hljs-property">ok</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RequestError</span>(
      <span class="hljs-string">`HTTP <span class="hljs-subst">${response.status}</span>: <span class="hljs-subst">${response.statusText}</span>`</span>,
      response.<span class="hljs-property">status</span>,
      response,
    );
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> response.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>() <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">ApiResponse</span>&lt;T&gt;&gt;;
}
</code></pre>
<p>业务代码的调用方式：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 普通 GET</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: userList } = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> request&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">User</span>[]&gt;(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/users'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">params</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">page</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">size</span>: <span class="hljs-number">20</span> },
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// POST</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: result } = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> request&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">CreateResult</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/users'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">method</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'POST'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">body</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'ErpanOmer'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">role</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'admin'</span> }),
});

<span class="hljs-comment">// 带手动取消的请求（用于搜索框等竞态场景）</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> controller = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { data } = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> request&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">SearchResult</span>[]&gt;(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/search'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">params</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">keyword</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'react'</span> },
  <span class="hljs-attr">signal</span>: controller.<span class="hljs-property">signal</span>,
});
<span class="hljs-comment">// 需要取消时</span>
controller.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>();
</code></pre>
<p><strong>对比一下改造前后的依赖变化</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-diff" lang="diff">// package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
<span class="hljs-deletion">-   "axios": "^1.7.2",</span>
<span class="hljs-deletion">-   "axios-retry": "^4.1.0",</span>
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>两个包删掉，<code>gzip</code> 后减少约 <strong>7 KB</strong>。7 KB 听起来不多，但如果你的项目还挂着 <code>lodash</code>、<code>moment</code>、<code>antd</code> 全量引入，这种顺手减负积少成多，对移动端首屏性能的贡献是实打实的🫡。</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-6"><code>fetch</code> 封装必须踩得坑，讲清楚</h3>
<p>别急着全盘照抄上面那 30 行。原生 <code>fetch</code> 有几个坑，如果你不处理，上了生产一定会翻车。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-7"><code>fetch</code> 只在网络层失败时 <code>reject</code></h4>
<p>这是 <code>fetch</code> 和 <code>axios</code> <strong>最大的行为差异</strong>。<code>axios</code> 在收到 <code>4xx</code> / <code>5xx</code> 响应时会直接走 <code>catch</code>，但 <code>fetch</code> 不会。对 <code>fetch</code> 来说，只要服务端返回了响应（哪怕是 <code>500</code>），就算请求成功。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/52f6bb726b2f4f19b4a99bf3ebf2502e~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1793667606&amp;x-signature=jB3%2FwWVZhdk9Asyc0858A%2FUg804%3D" alt="fetch 与 axios 的 500 响应对比.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>所以上面那段 <code>if (!response.ok)</code> 的判断是<strong>生命线</strong>，绝对不能省。漏了这一步，你的 <code>try/catch</code> 会安静地吞掉所有服务端错误，页面一片祥和，数据全是空的 🤷‍♂️。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-8"><code>Token</code> 过期后的无感刷新</h4>
<p>如果你的系统有 <code>Token</code> 刷新机制，在 <code>axios</code> 里通常是挂一个 <code>response</code> 拦截器来做。在 <code>fetch</code> 封装里同样可以实现，而且逻辑更加透明：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 在 request 函数内部，response.ok 判断之前加入</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (response.<span class="hljs-property">status</span> === <span class="hljs-number">401</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> refreshed = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">tryRefreshToken</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (refreshed) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 用新 Token 重发原请求</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> newToken = <span class="hljs-variable language_">localStorage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getItem</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'access_token'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> retryHeaders = { ...mergedHeaders, <span class="hljs-title class_">Authorization</span>: <span class="hljs-string">`Bearer <span class="hljs-subst">${newToken}</span>`</span> };
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> retryResponse = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${BASE_URL}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${url}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${queryString}</span>`</span>, {
      ...rest,
      <span class="hljs-attr">headers</span>: retryHeaders,
      signal, <span class="hljs-comment">// 注意：复用原来的 signal，保证外层取消仍然生效</span>
    });
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!retryResponse.<span class="hljs-property">ok</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RequestError</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Retry failed'</span>, retryResponse.<span class="hljs-property">status</span>, retryResponse);
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> retryResponse.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>() <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">ApiResponse</span>&lt;T&gt;&gt;;
  }
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 刷新失败，踢回登录页</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">location</span>.<span class="hljs-property">href</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'/login'</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RequestError</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Session expired'</span>, <span class="hljs-number">401</span>, response);
}
</code></pre>
<p>这段逻辑在 <code>axios</code> 的拦截器里也能做，但区别是：<strong>拦截器里的逻辑是隐藏的，你需要打开一个单独的文件去找；而函数封装里的逻辑是线性的，你从上往下读就能看到完整的请求生命周期。</strong></p>
<h4 data-id="heading-9">并发请求时的 <code>Token</code> 刷新竞态</h4>
<p>如果页面同时发了 5 个请求，其中第 1 个发现 <code>Token</code> 过期开始刷新，此时第 2 到第 5 个请求怎么办？如果它们也各自触发刷新，就会同时发出 5 个 <code>refresh</code> 请求，导致旧的 <code>Refresh Token</code> 被覆盖、多端登录态混乱。</p>
<p>兜底方案是加一个<strong>刷新锁</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">refreshPromise</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>&gt; | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">tryRefreshToken</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果已经有一个刷新请求在飞，复用它的 Promise</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (refreshPromise) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> refreshPromise;
  
  refreshPromise = (<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${BASE_URL}</span>/api/auth/refresh`</span>, {
        <span class="hljs-attr">method</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'POST'</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">headers</span>: { <span class="hljs-string">'Content-Type'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'application/json'</span> },
        <span class="hljs-attr">body</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>({
          <span class="hljs-attr">refreshToken</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">localStorage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getItem</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'refresh_token'</span>),
        }),
      });
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!res.<span class="hljs-property">ok</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { data } = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> res.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>();
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">localStorage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setItem</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'access_token'</span>, data.<span class="hljs-property">accessToken</span>);
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">localStorage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">setItem</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'refresh_token'</span>, data.<span class="hljs-property">refreshToken</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
      refreshPromise = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 刷新完成，释放锁</span>
    }
  })();
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> refreshPromise;
}
</code></pre>
<p>这段代码保证：<strong>无论同时有多少个请求触发了 <code>401</code>，<code>refresh</code> 只会发一次，所有后续请求都在等同一个 <code>Promise</code>。</strong> 这一层在 <code>axios</code> 拦截器里同样需要自己写，它并不会帮你解决。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-10"><code>AbortSignal.timeout()</code> 的浏览器兼容</h4>
<p><code>AbortSignal.timeout()</code> 是 2022 年才进入规范的 API。在极少数需要兼容老旧 <code>WebView</code>（比如部分低端安卓设备的内嵌浏览器）的场景下，需要手动 <code>polyfill</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">createTimeoutSignal</span>(<span class="hljs-params">ms: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortSignal</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 优先使用原生实现</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-string">'timeout'</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortSignal</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortSignal</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">timeout</span>(ms);
  }
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 降级方案</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> controller = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>();
  <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> controller.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">DOMException</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Timeout'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'TimeoutError'</span>)), ms);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> controller.<span class="hljs-property">signal</span>;
}
</code></pre>
<p>绝大多数现代浏览器已经支持，但<strong>兜底一定要写</strong>！</p>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">什么时候 <code>axios</code> 仍要使用？</h3>
<p>我不是要把 <code>axios</code> 一棒子打死。以下场景它仍然有优势：</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/109fc1883f2e407491f98b0feda33826~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgRXJwYW5PbWVy:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1793667606&amp;x-signature=bVkUDKcC6BWYFy8H50QN%2BnkhUSY%3D" alt="Axios 仍适用的两种场景.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>上传进度监控</strong>：<code>fetch</code> 目前没有原生的上传进度 API（下载进度可以用 <code>ReadableStream</code>），如果你的业务有大文件上传且需要显示进度条，<code>XMLHttpRequest</code> 的 <code>upload.onprogress</code> 目前仍然是唯一方案。</li>
<li><strong>遗留项目迁移成本过高</strong>：如果你的项目有上百处 <code>axios</code> 调用且工作良好，纯粹为了干净去替换，投入产出比不划算。规范约束新代码即可。</li>
</ul>
<p>但对于 2026 年的新项目来说，<strong><code>fetch</code> 就是那个你不需要安装的、零成本的、全运行时兼容的标准答案</strong>。</p>
<p>好了，今天就分享到这里🙌</p>
